summary: Closed O-023 and O-026 by widening the call-site fitness entry and holding its twin copy to it. The static-import and alias patterns now allow global::, an extern alias, spaces and line breaks about the dots, and the Start boundary now catches any Start* member (only StartedLine is let by). RescanElevationGuardTests now reads the directive patterns from the fitness entry instead of keeping a copy. The class is enumerated in RescanElevationRulesCorpus.json as rows E17-E35, with an attempt1 column recomputed from the first build's patterns. Before the fix the new rows and the engine's six theory rows failed; the full suite then passed (1643, 0 failed), and the SL-008 exe-level script, run unelevated, held end to end.

files.why: call-site entry: Start boundary widened to Start(?!edLine\b) so any Start* forwarder fires; the static-import and alias patterns use [\w.:\s]* so global::, extern-alias qualifiers, spaces and line breaks are caught; the because text says so
the code review's test for O-023, as given
the code review's test for O-026, as given
rows E17-E35 for the class 'spellings that reach RescanAsAdministrator.Start without spelling it', an attempt1Patterns block and a per-row attempt1 column, and a note
new fact recomputing the attempt1 column from the first build's patterns and requiring at least 10 rows they let by that are now caught

MainWindowDoesNotImportOrAliasTheClass reads the entry's two using-directive patterns from fitness.yaml (no copy); StartName widened to Start(?!edLine\b); new fact that RescanAsAdministrator.cs calls its start delegate once, inside Start, and that no member of it calls Start

obligations.how: The call-site entry's alias and static-import patterns became '(?m)\busing\s+static\s+[\w.:\s]*\bRescanAsAdministrator\b' and '(?m)\busing\s+\w+\s*=\s*[\w.:\s]*\bRescanAsAdministrator\b' in .taad/fitness.yaml. The guard test now takes those two patterns from the entry itself. CrSl008UsingDirectiveSpellingsTests is in the tree as given. Before the fix its three rows failed (Filter not matched); after, they pass, as does the full suite (1643 passed).

Same widened directive patterns (global::, global using, an extern-alias qualifier, spaces and line breaks) plus the forwarder half: the entry's Start pattern is now '\bRescanAsAdministrator\s*\.\s*Start(?!edLine\b)', so StartFor, StartAsync and StartElevated fire and StartedLine does not. A new guard fact holds RescanAsAdministrator.cs to one call of its start delegate, inside Start, with no other member calling Start. Corpus rows E17-E35 enumerate the class (qualified, project-wide, alias, extern alias, line-broken, forwarders, and quiet neighbours). RescanStartGlobalQualifiedImportTests is in the tree as given. Before the fix, rows E17-E21, E23-E25 and E27-E29 and six theory rows failed; after, all pass.

mandatory.where: Decided that the elevated copy keeps the PS-012 finished whole-drive coverage line word for word. Nothing is written for it: MainWindow.xaml.cs's Coverage wording is unchanged in both copies, and this attempt touched no src file.

ALL CHECKS HELD, exit 0. The UAC press itself is not driven (lesson #24).

The rule matches code only (Fitness blanks comments), so a directive with a comment between its tokens (using static /* x */ ...) is not covered by the widened patterns; the corpus bounds the class by accidental spellings, and the guard test, which reads raw text, would catch it in MainWindow.xaml.cs only.
